sources.title: blog/ettin-reranker.md at main · huggingface/blog · GitHub
sources.snippet: The ettin-reranker-v1 family, trained with a single simple recipe, is state-of-the-art at every released size up to 1B parameters. Pointwise MSE distillation from a strong teacher onto a broad-domain and retrieval-specific mix scales cleanly from 17M to 1B parameters, with only the learning rate and per-device batch size changing between sizes.
